tasks.title: IT Support · DEMO-001 · Internet down across demo site
tasks.next_action: Escalate the reported production outage to the IT Support lead before investigating; confirm the affected site and available continuity procedure.
tasks.action_plan:
1. Escalate the reported production outage to the IT Support lead before investigating; confirm the affected site and available continuity procedure.
Verify: Record lead acknowledgement, affected service and incident reference; priority remains a proposal until reviewed.
2. Inspect authorized switch/AP link, PoE and port status; compare affected and working devices.
Verify: Record port/link indicators and whether the failure follows one device, AP, VLAN or whole site.
3. Inspect assigned IP, DHCP lease, gateway and DNS settings; compare with the approved network design.
Verify: Record which layer differs from a working device; redact addresses or logs before sharing outside the team.
4. Propose a reversible fix only after the failing component is verified; obtain reviewer approval before configuration changes, restart, reset or remote execution.
Verify: Record approved change, rollback plan and a before/after functional check.
